name: The LGBT Asylum Project
description: Accessible legal representation for low-income LGBTQ+ asylum seekers
fullDescription: The LGBT Asylum Project (Center for Immigrant Protection) is a San Francisco nonprofit dedicated to providing accessible legal representation for LGBTQ+ asylum seekers fleeing persecution based on sexual orientation, gender identity, or HIV status.
whatTheyOffer:
- Legal representation for LGBTQ+ asylum cases
- Help preparing asylum applications
- DACA applications and renewals
- Services for low- and no-income clients
- Connection to community resources
howToGetIt:
1. Go to the Get Help page on lgbtasylumproject.org
2. Fill out the online Initial Intake Form
3. Must identify as LGBTQ+ and have experienced or fear persecution in your home country
4. Must live within the San Francisco Asylum Office area (Bakersfield, CA north to Alaska)
5. Office is in the Castro at 526 Castro Street
